title: Exact colimits preserve the preorder bar augmentation
statement: Let I be a preorder and A an abelian category with coproducts and exact colimits of shape I. For any diagram D:I→CochainComplex(A,Int) and specified colimit cocone c, the canonical total bar augmentation [def-sc-preorder-bar-total] to c.pt is a quasi-isomorphism. No bound on the complexes is required.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: The lower-ideal bars have colimit the full bar, and their augmentations have colimit the supplied colimit cocone on D. Each lower-ideal augmentation is a homotopy equivalence because that lower ideal has greatest object j. Exact colimits preserve quasi-isomorphisms: apply MorphismProperty.colimitsOfShape_le for HomologicalComplex.quasiIso, as proved in the source-library GrothendieckAxioms.Colim module. Naturality of augmentation identifies the resulting colimit map with the canonical total augmentation.
